SAIL Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SAIL Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Steel Authority of India (SAIL) for its Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant facility located in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in SAIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post offered under this advertisement is Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) under the Proficiency Trainee program for an 18-month duration.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Dresser Cum Compounder post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for SAIL Dresser Cum Compounder Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates need not apply online and can directly attend the interview as per schedule.

faq.question: Q5. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) post is scheduled to be held on 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Intermediate (10+2) with Science, Diploma or Certificate in Dresser/Compounder, B.Sc (Nursing), or GNM/ANM with a valid Certificate of Registration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit and relaxation applicable for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years, with appropriate age relaxations provided for OBC, SC, and ST candidates as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or stipend offered during the training period?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a basic stipend of Rs. 10,000/- per month along with additional Knowledge Enhancement Allowances based on attendance.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any application fees to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry a filled application form, qualification certificates, Aadhaar card, PAN card, birth certificate, caste certificate, address proof, and passport-size photographs.
